svg.title: Bivariate normal distribution: joint surface and contours
svg.desc: Two representations of the same centered bivariate Gaussian density with unit variances and covariance 0.6. The first panel shows an isometric mesh of the density surface and the second shows nested elliptical density contours tilted in the positive correlation direction.
svg.text: Bivariate normal distribution: joint surface and contours
Positive correlation tilts the elliptical contours.
The surface and contour diagram represent the same two-variable distribution.
